content.title: About
content.content: Tomato and vegetable juice, 100% is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from fresh tomatoes and a blend of vegetables such as carrots, celery, beetroot and bell pepper. The juice contains no added sugar, preservatives or flavorings and retains most of the vitamins and minerals of the raw vegetables.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Tomato juice is rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant whose availability increases with mild heating.
Combining tomatoes with carrots and beetroot enhances the bioavailability of beta‑carotene.
In Russia this juice is often used in detox programs and as a base for vegetable soups.
Pasteurisation preserves over 80% of vitamin C while extending shelf life.
Tomato juice is traditionally considered heart‑healthy because of its potassium content.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Lycopene and potassium help regulate blood pressure and reduce the risk of atherosclerosis.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Vitamin C, vitamin E and carotenoids neutralise free radicals, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Immune system boost
items.content: B‑vitamins and vitamin C support normal immune function.

items.title: Vision health
items.content: Beta‑carotene and vitamin A from carrots and tomatoes are essential for eye health.

items.title: Anti‑inflammatory effects
items.content: Phytochemicals such as polyphenols have mild anti‑inflammatory properties.

items.title: Tomato allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to tomatoes or other vegetables in the blend.

items.title: High sodium if salt is added
items.content: When the juice contains added salt, people with hypertension should monitor their intake.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Tomato juice has a low pH, which can cause heartburn in people with acid reflux.

items.title: Natural sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, the natural sugars may affect blood glucose levels in diabetics; moderation is advised.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled, use it as a base for smoothies, vegetable soups or sauces. It can be diluted with water to reduce acidity. It pairs well with herbs, lemon and spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C in a sealed container and consume within 5 days after opening. Keep away from direct sunlight and high temperatures to preserve vitamin C.
